title: ChatGPT is not A Man but Das Man: Representativeness and Structural Consistency of Silicon Samples Generated by Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Conditioning LLMs with 395 intersectional demographic personas (combining sex, race, education, and religion) to answer survey questions, and comparing the models' predicted probability distributions against actual ANES 2020 survey data to evaluate structural consistency and response homogenization.

Evaluating the variance and distribution of LLM-generated opinions on highly contentious political issues (abortion and unauthorized immigration) to determine if models artificially homogenize responses and erase minority political viewpoints within specific demographic subgroups.
